target: capitulum inflorescence (PO_0030121)
reason: Exact in sense: a flowerhead is a head, and 'head' is already a BROAD synonym of capitulum inflorescence. The 2026-11-13 review mapped 'head' (C262) the same way.

target: tepal (PO_0009033) as a member of a series, with a lateral position (pattern D, 'which member of a series')
reason: A position in a series of tepals, not a separate structure. The bearer is tepal and 'lateral' is a position quality of the bearer. Pattern D is designed but has no position value classes yet.

target: style (PO_0009074) with the pinned BSPO apical region as part_restrictions (region rule in docs/annotation-context-patterns.md); unqualified fallback plant organ apex (FLOPO_0985023)
reason: PO has no style apex class, so by the region rule the style stays the bearer and the value is stated of its apical region.

A truncated quality word ('homogamous') from 'homogamous spikelet pairs' in Andropogoneae. The bearer is the spikelet pair (spikelet PO_0009051). Homogamous is the opposite of heterogamous (FLOPO:0991178) and should be a value term, not a part.

label: limbidium
parent: is_a PO_0009007 (portion of plant tissue); part_of PO_0025075 (non-vascular leaf)
definition: A portion of plant tissue (PO:0009007) of a non-vascular leaf (PO:0025075) that is a border of elongate, often thick-walled or hyaline cells, set apart from the other lamina cells, along or near the leaf margin, as in Fissidens.
reason: A real moss leaf structure used in four floras, mostly for Fissidens. Its row counts and continuity cannot be stated of leaf margin (PO_0020128) alone. Propose to PO upstream along with the other bryophyte leaf parts (PO already has costa PO_0030072).

target: trichome (PO_0000282) as the qualified whole: '3-8-rayed' is a count of the trichome's branches, and ray shape (acicular, furcate) is stated of a branch/distal region of the trichome
reason: The rays are the arms of stellate or radiate hairs. They can be expressed as parts of a trichome without a new class.

target: labellum lobe (FLOPO_0986028) with a lateral position in the series of lobes (pattern D)
reason: Here 'lip' is the orchid labellum (FLOPO:0980978). Its lateral lobes are labellum lobes in a lateral position.

Two senses in the data: the leaf-cell network of mosses (Ephemerum: lax, firm, dense) and the vein areolation of vascular leaves (Buchenavia: prominent). The 2026-11-13 review rejected 'areole' as generic for the same reason.

target: gemma (PO_0025614)
reason: Exact in sense: the multicellular asexual brood bodies of bryophytes are gemmae. (Single brood cells would be brachycyte PO_0030058.)

target: sepal (PO_0009031) with an inner position in the series (pattern D)
reason: A member of a series. The counts are counts of sepals at the inner position. Inner/outer value classes are still open.

target: sepal (PO_0009031) with an outer position in the series (pattern D)
reason: A member of a series, same as inner sepal.

target: leaf sheath (PO_0020104)
reason: Narrower: the sheath of a culm leaf in bamboos and other grasses ('culm' is a synonym of stem PO_0009047). Indumentum, colour and texture are all sheath qualities. Deciduous applies to the whole culm leaf, but the sheath is its main part.

target: plant cell (PO_0009002) as part of leaf base (PO_0020040; 'phyllid base' is a synonym)
reason: The examples are moss leaf descriptions of the cells at the leaf base. Expressed as a part (cells) of an existing region class.

target: leaf apex (PO_0020137; 'phyllid apex' is a synonym) of a non-vascular leaf (PO_0025075)
reason: Narrower: the long, narrow, awl-shaped upper part of a moss leaf (Campylopus, Dicranaceae). Its qualities (flexuose, fragile, hyaline) fit an apical region.

target: labellum lobe (FLOPO_0986028) with a median position in the series of lobes (pattern D)
reason: The middle lobe of a three-lobed orchid labellum. Not the same as the epichile (FLOPO_0986029), which is the distal part of a labellum divided across its length.

label: spadix pistillate zone
parent: is_a PO_0009011 (plant structure); part_of PO_0030120 (spadix inflorescence)
definition: A plant structure (PO:0009011) that is the portion of a spadix inflorescence (PO:0030120) bearing the pistillate flowers, together with the part of the spadix axis on which they are borne.
reason: Araceae floras describe the shape and size of each spadix zone. The 2026-11-13 review noted 'No class for the zones of a spadix in PO' when it added spadix appendix (FLOPO_0986049). Propose upstream together with the staminate and sterile zones and the appendix.

target: leaf midvein (PO_0020139)
reason: Exact for leaves (French 'médiane'). Some examples come from bracts or lemmas or are mixed with secondary veins. Those need the organ context.

target: plant cell (PO_0009002) as part of costa (PO_0030072); the marginal or terminal cells of the lamellae
reason: In Polytrichaceae the photosynthetic lamellae sit on the upper side of the costa. PO has no lamella class. A 'phyllid lamella' class would be more precise if more floras need it.

target: style (PO_0009074)
reason: Narrower: a style-like sterile extension of the carpel, carrying the stigmatic crest, in Schisandraceae (Kadsura, Schisandra) and some Annonaceae (Goniothalamus). Length and shape fit style.

label: vaginant lamina
parent: is_a PO_0025001 (cardinal organ part); part_of PO_0025075 (non-vascular leaf)
definition: A cardinal organ part (PO:0025001) of a non-vascular leaf (PO:0025075) that is the proximal, two-layered, sheathing portion of an equitant leaf, clasping the stem and the base of the next leaf, as in Fissidens.
reason: 'vagrant' is an extraction error for 'vaginant' (the examples say 'vaginant laminae'). Do not add 'vagrant lamina' as a synonym; fix the normalization instead. Many moss floras describe Fissidens leaves this way. Propose upstream with the dorsal and apical laminae.

target: bud scale leaf (PO_0020054)
reason: Exact: a perula is a bud scale ('bud scale' is a synonym of PO_0020054).

target: pinna (FLOPO_0985027)
reason: Narrower: the examples are first-order divisions of compound leaves (pairs, petiolate, opposite, 'of the lower leaves'). The 2026-11-13 review rejected the bare word 'division'; the 'primary' qualifier plus the leaf context makes this one usable.

target: fruit valve (PO_0000033)
reason: Narrower: the valve of a capsule fruit. The counts are valve counts ('valved' is already in flora_counted_parts.tsv).

target: inflorescence (PO_0009049)
reason: Narrower: a panicle-like compound inflorescence made of many smaller units (Andropogoneae and others). It is not a panicle inflorescence (PO_0030123), so it maps to the general inflorescence class. All statements are presence only.
A unit of mass (milligram). The bearer is the seed or embryo that is weighed. Same treatment as 'μm' and 'kg' in the 2026-11-13 review.

target: leaf epidermis (PO_0006016) by the surface rule; upper/lower surface goes to leaf adaxial epidermis (PO_0006018) / leaf abaxial epidermis (PO_0006019)
reason: A surface of a dorsiventral organ is PO's epidermis class for that side (docs/annotation-context-patterns.md). The 2026-11-13 review rejected bare 'surface' only because it had no organ.
Two unrelated senses: the transverse bars on the achene surface in Eleocharis ('in each longitudinal row'), and the bars on moss peristome teeth (Funaria, Entosthodon).

target: gemma (PO_0025614)
reason: Narrower/exact in this data: the examples are the specialised asexual propagules of bryophytes. Do not use PO's 'propagule' synonym of fruit (PO_0009001).

The second term of a relative length ('palea 1/2–2/3 the length of the lemma'). The bearer is the palea or glume. This belongs to the equality-and-ratios pattern with lemma (PO_0009037) as the comparison part.

target: vascular leaf (PO_0009025)
reason: Narrower: the needle-like leaf of conifers ('needle-like leaf' is a synonym of vascular leaf). '5-needle pine' and 'fascicles of 30 to 65 needles' are counts of leaves per fascicle.
